```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r wczytanie danych}

dane <- read.csv("sklep_rowerowy.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")
head(dane)
```

```{r}

library(finalfit)

missing_pattern(dane)

```

```{r przygotowanie danych do imputacji}
dane <- dane %>% janitor::clean_names() %>% select(-id)

summary(dane)
colSums(is.na(dane))

dane <- dane %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(., "")))

dane$marital_status <- as.factor(dane$marital_status)
dane$gender <- as.factor(dane$gender)
dane$home_owner <- as.factor(dane$home_owner)

```

```{r}
dane<- as.data.frame(dane)

dane$cars <- ifelse(is.na(dane$cars), mean(dane$cars, na.rm = TRUE), dane$cars)
dane$age <- ifelse(is.na(dane$age), mean(dane$age, na.rm = TRUE), dane$age)
dane$children <- ifelse(is.na(dane$children), mean(dane$children, na.rm = TRUE), dane$children)
dane$income <- ifelse(is.na(dane$income), mean(dane$income, na.rm = TRUE), dane$income)


missing_pattern(dane)

```
